verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since state filing offices can expose APIs. Nothing in the evidence shows any public API for Ohio Secretary of State filings or lookups. The documented surfaces are all UI portals with OHID sign-in (Gateway, OH|TAX), and the probes found ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning 403 even on robots.txt, so there is no documented programmatic path.
